summary: A Data Engineer plays a crucial role in designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our data-driven decisions.
responsibilities: Design & Develop Data Pipelines: Assist in building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines to ingest and transform large datasets from diverse sources, including APIs, databases, and third-party systems.
required_skills: Strong expertise in SQL and a deep understanding of relational database concepts.
Proven experience with Google BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse platform (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift).
Experience in configuring and managing data pipelines.
nice_to_have_skills: Familiarity with data governance and data modeling concepts.
Experience with Git and CI/CD best practices.
